page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside a poor bottom 10% rating in single-threaded gzip compression. However, the instance leverages its 24 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, stress-ng multi-core tests, and Geekbench multi-core scores all fall within the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth also remains average, with read-only large block speeds at 90.83 GB/sec and write speeds at 53.0 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can distribute processing across its 24 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high-speed local storage. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose computing, trading off high single-core clock speeds for stable, dedicated multi-core capacity.
